lesson: M25_Earnings_Mom_Streak showed OOS>1.8 in 5 base strategies but combined with V24_Residual_Income produces IC~0 and negative FF5 alpha in Korea. DD 10/25 brake reduced MDD from STR_1519's 61.9% to 41.89% (C2-compliant t-1 lag), confirming DD brake mechanics work, but cannot rescue a fundamentally weak signal. Stress outperformance 4/4 and recent 3Y SR 0.954 vs full 0.373 suggest possible regime-conditional value — M25 may only work in specific macro environments. Future: test M25 standalone without V24 dilution, or use M25 as a conditional signal in regime-aware ensemble rather than standalone factor.
